about.title: About Promos 2017
paragraphs: Promos 2017 gathers the 32 promo cards from 19 products released in 2017: Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2017 prize cards, Circuit Break Special Edition, Circuit Break Sneak Peek Participation Card, Code of the Duelist Special Edition, Code of the Duelist Sneak Peek Participation Card, WSJ Jump Pack Spring 2017 promotional card, WSJ Jump Pack Fall 2017 promotional card, Weekly Shonen Jump January 2017 membership promotional card, Weekly Shonen Jump April 2017 membership promotional card, Weekly Shonen Jump July 2017 membership promotional card, Weekly Shonen Jump November 2017 membership promotional card, Maximum Crisis: Special Edition, Maximum Crisis Sneak Peek Participation Card, Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dark Side of Dimensions Blu-ray & DVD promotional card, Raging Tempest: Special Edition, Raging Tempest Sneak Peek Participation Card, Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V Volume 1 promotional card, Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V Volume 2 promotional card and Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series 2017 prize card.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 32 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 34, adding the 2 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
